comparison.objective: Candidate locks an adjusted robot-gripper stop; PR-1868 connects a hose nipple to a sprung quick-connect coupler.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate counterholds a screw while tightening its jam nut; PR-1868 retracts a sprung collar while aligning and inserting a flexible-hose fitting, then releases it to latch.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires retained angle and repeatable articulated motion; PR-1868 requires seated pawl engagement, collar return, pull retention, stillness and hand clearance.
comparison.reason: Both culminate in hands-off retention, but quick-connect insertion under collar spring load does not test locknut preservation of an adjustable setting; no rubric details are missing.
